'''In-iK''' was a droid sent by the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] to repair [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] required repairs. In Coruscant's distant history, the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] had a hand in building some of Coruscant's infrastructure, so at some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] reached out to the Gree for aid.<ref name="Hydro" />

However the Gree was isolationists, and instead, sent [[Droid/Legends|droid]] representatives to aid in the rebuilding efforts. These representatives included [[Pat-aK]], the lead [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] droid assigned to work with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Oranda]], [[Hib-R-ak]], the subordinate droid responsible for the [[waste processing system]], [[Nam-aK]], the droid assigned to the [[hydrosupply]], and In-iK, the droid responsible for the power systems.<ref name="Hydro" />

Initially, the Gree droids had difficulty communicating with their [[Alien/Legends|alien]] collaborators due to their tendency to fall back on [[Gree (language)|Gree speech patterns]] when their [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] speech programming was insufficient to convey their ideas.<ref name="Hydro" />

An agent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who had traveled to Coruscant on other business happened upon Oranda and Pat-aK attempting and failing a conversation and was able to discern much more about Pat-aK's troubles than Oranda was. The individual was able to determine that Pat-aK's subordinates had fallen under attack by hostile forces who had taken control of various sections of Coruscant's lower levels, interrupting the repair work. The Republic agent needed to access these areas anyway in the course of their other business, and so they agreed to take on some jobs for Pat-aK and Oranda to help repair Coruscant.<ref name="Hydro" />

After the individual, designated in the Gree language as a "black bisector", repaired the hydrosupply systems for Nam-aK and solved a problem with [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] saboteurs for Hib-r-aK, they were contacted by In-iK. In-iK asked them to travel into [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] and repair three damaged power conduits. The individual succeeded in doing so, braving the [[Mobile|rogue droids]], [[Cthon/Legends|Cthon]], and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces within the Works and preventing planet-wide blackouts.<ref name="Power">{{TORcite|type=general|Gree: Power Outage|Coruscant}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
In-iK and the other Gree droid ambassadors were largely similar to basic model [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], but were somewhat dissimilar in their programming. These droids spoke some Basic but fell back on Gree speech patterns of colors and geometry when trying to explain concepts that they were unable to enunciate otherwise.<ref name="Power" />

==Behind the scenes==
In-iK was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. After the Republic player has completed the missions "Gree: Hydrosupply Leak" and "Gree: Ugnaught Saboteurs" on Coruscant, they are given the mission "Gree: Power Outage" by In-iK. In-iK asks them to repair three power conduits within the Works, which will prevent a catastrophic power failure and city-wide blackouts.<ref name="Power" />
